title: What Your Body Does 200 Billion Times A Day
sources: Swallowing: healthy adults swallow roughly 500-700 times a day, about 585 on average (Lear et al. 1965, Archives of Oral Biology)
Blinking: about 15-20 blinks a minute while awake, roughly 14,000-19,000 a day (Bentivoglio et al. 1997, Movement Disorders; American Academy of Ophthalmology)
Breathing: 12-16 breaths a minute at rest, roughly 17,000-23,000 a day (Cleveland Clinic, vital signs)
Heartbeat: about 70 beats a minute, roughly 100,000 a day (American Heart Association)

Red blood cells: the bone marrow makes about 2 million new red blood cells every second, roughly 200 billion a day (Dzierzak & Philipsen 2013, Cold Spring Harbor Perspectives in Medicine; Higgins 2015)
